agentParams.aiRole: Senior Business Analyst and UX Specialist
instructions: Read ticket details from input folder (automatically prepared)
Extract Figma URL from ticket description or specified custom field
Discover all screens in the Figma design using dmtools CLI:
dmtools figma_get_layers "FIGMA_URL_WITH_NODE_ID"
Download screen previews for visual analysis:
dmtools figma_download_node_image --data '{"href": "FIGMA_URL", "nodeId": "123:456", "format": "png", "scale": 2}'
Analyze screens with AI multimodal to match them to Acceptance Criteria:
dmtools gemini_ai_chat_with_files --data '{"message": "Analyze these screens", "filePaths": ["/path/to/screen.png"]}'
Parse existing Acceptance Criteria from story description
If story has ACs: Match each AC to relevant Figma screen(s)
If story has NO ACs: Suggest ACs based on the design screens
Generate Markdown output with design references
Write JSON result to outputs/response.md following the format from formattingRules
IMPORTANT: Return valid JSON that can be parsed by postJSAction
IMPORTANT: Use screen IDs in colon format (123:456) in JSON output
./agents/instructions/figma/ac_matching_rules.md
./agents/instructions/common/response_output.md
./agents/instructions/common/preserve_references.md
./agents/instructions/common/media_handling.md
./agents/instructions/common/jira_context.md
./agents/instructions/common/json_validation.md
agentParams.knownInfo: Figma MCP tools: figma_get_layers (get screens), figma_download_node_image (download screenshots), figma_get_node_details (get properties). AI tools: gemini_ai_chat_with_files (multimodal analysis with images).

cliCommands: ./cicd/scripts/run-cursor-agent.sh "Read input folder. Extract Figma URL from ticket. Use dmtools figma_get_layers to discover screens. Download screen images with figma_download_node_image. Analyze with gemini_ai_chat_with_files. Match screens to ACs. Write JSON output to outputs/response.md. Validate JSON before finish."
